description: Remote image policy: https/http/protocol-relative images are blocked from the asset list when allowRemoteImages is false (default). Local relative and fragment images survive in assets. file: and javascript: schemes are blocked. The img elements with safe-but-remote URLs (https/http) survive in HTML because the sanitizer allows them — the filtering happens at the asset-list level, not the HTML level. unsafe-scheme img elements (javascript:/file:) are removed entirely by the URL policy.
